integrity: The proof is symbolic. The focal source was inspected in full around Theorems 2.2 and 2.4 and its Online First date and MSC data were verified from the journal record. No independence or external validation is claimed.
limitations: The theorem gives the complete parameter multiset for fixed n but not a closed form for the number of distinct attained values, because different divisors of L can collide under F. The finite replay is regression evidence only.
title: Exact parameter orbit law for the additive gcd-exponent function
